name: sockleak
description: Socket teardown leaks nothing a later run needs: plain loopprobe runs its loopback TCP cases three times in one boot -- listen, connect and accept on 127.0.0.1, bytes both ways, end of file -- and each run must pass as the first did.  Its listener sets SO_REUSEADDR, since a run right after another meets TIME_WAIT on the port.  apple/fgx#132 began as a chip socket the loopback path never gave back; the sockets are the kernel stack's now, and the three runs still prove a close returns what the socket held.
